title: Operations & Delivery Manager
description:
Operations & Delivery Manager IT Hardware Manufacturing & Software Projects 
 ey Responsibilities 1. Factory & IT Hardware Manufacturing Manage daily factory operations, production planning and manufacturing activities. Supervise assembly, testing and production of Desktop PCs, AIO PCs, Thin Clients, Kiosks, Smart Displays and other IT hardware products. Manage PCB/PCBA assembly coordination, component integration, firmware installation and product testing. Ensure production targets, product quality and on-time dispatch. Monitor manpower utilization, production efficiency and manufacturing costs. Implement SOPs, quality checks, 5S and lean manufacturing practices. Coordinate with purchase, stores, quality and engineering teams. 2. Software Project Delivery Coordinate with software development teams for timely delivery of web, mobile and enterprise applications. Track software project schedules, milestones, deliverables and resource allocation. Monitor development, testing, UAT, deployment and customer handover. Coordinate between software developers, project managers, QA and customers. Ensure timely completion of software projects within approved budgets. Manage software-related escalations and delivery challenges. Ensure hardware and software integration for customized IT products. 3. Project Execution & Customer Delivery Manage complete project execution from purchase order to final customer acceptance. Plan hardware production, software readiness, dispatch, installation and commissioning. Coordinate multi-location installations and government IT projects. Monitor project timelines, manpower deployment and vendor performance. Ensure timely completion of FAT, SAT, UAT and customer sign-off. Maintain project documentation, delivery reports and installation records. Resolve project delays, operational issues and customer escalations. 4. Procurement, Inventory & Quality Coordinate material planning, procurement and inventory availability. Monitor BOM, stock levels, material shortages and vendor deliveries. Ensure quality inspection, product testing and manufacturing compliance. Reduce production wastage, rework and operational costs. Coordinate with suppliers, OEMs and contract manufacturers. Ensure finished products meet technical specifications and customer requirements. 5. Team Management & MIS Reporting Manage production, software delivery, quality, stores and project execution teams. Allocate manpower and monitor team productivity. Conduct daily production and weekly project review meetings. Maintain production MIS, project trackers and delivery dashboards. Report operational performance, project risks and delays to management. Drive process improvement and operational efficiency.

Key Skills: Business operations,Management,Delivery management,Planning,Operations management,Delivery,Operations planning,Operations
